data.one_liner: An autocomplete text field for Flutter supporting multiple datatypes.
data.what_it_does: Provides an autocomplete text field widget that displays suggestions matching the user input. It supports custom data types and allows dynamic updates to the suggestions list.
use_when: You need a text field with autocomplete suggestions for forms.
You want to support non-string custom datatypes in your autocomplete list.
avoid_when: You require active maintenance, as the author no longer uses Flutter frequently.
strengths: Supports any data type for suggestions
Allows dynamic updates, adding, and removing of suggestions
Exposes text field options and input formatters
weaknesses: Limited active maintenance from the author
